tasks.label: Publish + Deploy Blazor BFF to Azure
Publish + Deploy Blazor UI to Azure
Migrate Local DB (SQL Server)
tasks.command: ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development Database__UseLocalConnection=true dotnet dotnet-ef database update --project "${workspaceFolder}/PerFi.Infrastructure/PerFi.Infrastructure.csproj" --startup-project "${workspaceFolder}/PerFi.API/PerFi.API.csproj"

tasks.label: Create User Account (Local DB)
tasks.command: DOTNET_ENVIRONMENT=Development ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development Database__UseLocalConnection=true dotnet run --project "${workspaceFolder}/PerFi.Console/PerFi.Console.csproj" -- create-user "${input:perfiNewUsername}" "${input:perfiNewPassword}"

tasks.label: Import Example Data (Local DB)
tasks.command: DOTNET_ENVIRONMENT=Development ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development Database__UseLocalConnection=true dotnet run --project "${workspaceFolder}/PerFi.Console/PerFi.Console.csproj" -- import-net-worth "${input:perfiImportFile}" --username "${input:perfiImportUsername}"

tasks.label: Import Example Data (Remote DB)
tasks.command: DOTNET_ENVIRONMENT=Development ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development Database__UseLocalConnection=false dotnet run --project "${workspaceFolder}/PerFi.Console/PerFi.Console.csproj" -- import-net-worth "${input:perfiImportFile}" --username "${input:perfiImportUsername}"

tasks.label: Import Transactions (Local DB)
tasks.command: DOTNET_ENVIRONMENT=Development ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development Database__UseLocalConnection=true dotnet run --project "${workspaceFolder}/PerFi.Console/PerFi.Console.csproj" -- import-transactions "${input:perfiTransactionsImportFile}" --username "${input:perfiImportUsername}"

tasks.label: Import Transactions (Remote DB)
tasks.command: DOTNET_ENVIRONMENT=Development ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development Database__UseLocalConnection=false dotnet run --project "${workspaceFolder}/PerFi.Console/PerFi.Console.csproj" -- import-transactions "${input:perfiTransactionsImportFile}" --username "${input:perfiImportUsername}"

tasks.label: Import Contributions (Local DB)
tasks.command: DOTNET_ENVIRONMENT=Development ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development Database__UseLocalConnection=true dotnet run --project "${workspaceFolder}/PerFi.Console/PerFi.Console.csproj" -- import-contributions "${input:perfiContributionsImportFile}" --username "${input:perfiImportUsername}"

tasks.label: Import Contributions (Remote DB)
tasks.command: DOTNET_ENVIRONMENT=Development ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development Database__UseLocalConnection=false dotnet run --project "${workspaceFolder}/PerFi.Console/PerFi.Console.csproj" -- import-contributions "${input:perfiContributionsImportFile}" --username "${input:perfiImportUsername}"

tasks.label: Delete All Data (Local DB)
tasks.command: Database__UseLocalConnection=true docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
